expected_level_description: You can: - coach and lead teams in Agile and Lean good practices - create and tailor the right approach for a team, challenging, evaluating and iterating the approach through the life cycle - experiment with new and innovative ways of working to improve delivery across the organisation - act as a recognised expert and advocate for Agile and Lean approaches
You can: - act as the escalation point and resolve large or high risk commercial management issues - coach others in appropriate commercial management

skill: Communicating between the technical and non-technical
expected_level_description: You can: - mediate between people and strengthen relationships, adopting the appropriate communication method with stakeholders at all levels - manage stakeholder expectations and moderate difficult discussions about high risk and complex topics, even within constrained timescales - speak on behalf of, and represent the community to, large audiences inside and outside the organisation
You can: - negotiate, influence or set budgets in complex environments - write or input into business cases and can communicate business-value propositions

You can: - lead and coach teams through different phases of the life cycle - ensure effective support for the product or service and its users - predict, prevent, mitigate and manage potential risks at different phases of the life cycle - contribute to the assessment of other teams, providing guidance and support

You can: - optimise the delivery flow of teams - actively address the most complicated risks, issues and dependencies including where ownership exists outside the team or no clear ownership exists - identify innovative ways to unblock issues

You can: - identify and challenge organisational processes of increasing complexity and those processes that are unnecessarily complicated - add value and can coach the organisation to inspect and adapt processes - guide teams through the implementation of a new process

You can: - lead a continual planning process in a very complex environment - plan beyond product delivery - identify dependencies in plans across services and co-ordinate delivery - coach other teams as the central point of expertise

You can: - change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs - lead on strategy for an entire organisation, joining up business needs with innovative analysis - make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity - effectively build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders - solve and unblock issues within teams or departments at the highest level - understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills - coach an organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
